name: okr-merge
title_zh: 几位创始人各写一版 OKR，它合成一份并排到每周
tagline_zh: 三个人三份 OKR，谁的目标都重要、谁的产能都不够——它先把冲突摊开让你拍板，再把定稿拆成每人每周该盯的那一件事。
tagline_en: Three founders, three drafts, one shared capacity. It surfaces the conflicts for you to decide, then turns the.
desc_en: Brings a founding team's individual OKR drafts (or an already-agreed set) into one final, hardened version - resolving disagreement and capacity conflicts across the group - then builds a per-person week-by-week focus plan tied to it. Use when a team is merging OKRs, reconciling drafts from multiple founders, hardening an OKR set they agreed on themselves without AI, or turning confirmed OKRs into
why_zh: 它不替你写 OKR，只做合并与硬化：把分歧、重复、产能超载逐条摆出来，你点头才落定，再往下排周计划。
why_en: It doesn't write your OKRs; it merges and hardens them — surfacing disagreement, overlap and overload for your call, then.
limit_zh: 只处理 OKR 这一层，不管 KPI、绩效打分和薪酬；合并结果要你逐条确认才落定，全自动跑完会停在待确认处。
limit_en: OKR layer only — no KPIs, ratings or comp. Merges pause for your per-item confirmation; weekly plans stop at 'what to watch this week', no task.
